name: Harbor Creative
description: Helps local consumer brands develop clear launch strategy, content plans, and measurement frameworks.
backgroundText: Harbor Creative is a fictional small creative strategy agency. It prepares practical launch strategies, content plans, and measurement frameworks for local consumer brands. No awards, past clients, or performance claims are implied.
policiesText: The standard four-week launch strategy package costs USD 6,000 and includes discovery, audience and message strategy, a four-week content calendar, and a measurement plan. It excludes ad spend, ongoing campaign management, custom website development, and guaranteed revenue outcomes.
